NIGHTCLUB MANAGEMENT (NightClub PC — your own club, post-acquire via Landlord Swaying Bazongas): Runs on 4 metrics — pop ($nc_pop = popularity 0-100+), risks ($nc_risks = police visibility, =pop × 3 × risk_percentage_mod), capacity_drinks (drinks stocked) and capacity_drugs (if Backroom Deals unlocked). POP RAISE FORMULA per day: +1 if <20, 0 if 20-49, -1 if 50-74, -2 if >=75 (diminishing returns — success brings decline unless feeding). Entrance price: 5$ +1 pop, 10$ neutral, 15$ -1 pop. Drinks: if capacity_drinks < pop*5 → -1 pop. Drugs Backroom: if drugs > pop*4 → +1 pop. INCOME: base = (entrance × pop) + (50 × pop) = 55-65 × pop standard, -0 if drinks short = 5×(entrance×pop) loss. Drugs revenue: drugs_use × 12$. LAUNDRY: 100 × pop = dirty→clean (biggest structured laundry in game). Tax: 500$ base + 200$ per autobuy. UPGRADES (8 items, 10-50k$): Stripper Poles 20k$+500/d (+pop bonus), Backroom Deals 15k$ (unlocks drug channel), Gloryhole Booths ?, Extra Bouncers, CCTV, Boss's Order (PC-customizable drink), Gambling Tables, Preferred Guests Program. All except Boss's Order/Program have REFUND button (e.g. Stripper poles sell back at 7.5k vs 20k buy = 37.5% resale). Club is THE LAUNDRY ENGINE — 100/pop * 50 pop = 5000$/day clean conversion. BROTHEL UPGRADES: Restoration 30k$ (+50 quality +10 slut slots), VIP booths 45k$, scaling quality_mods.

JUNKYARD SCRAP SHACK (Outskirts — post-gang buyout 50k$ + 170$/day maintenance, +250 rep on purchase): SCRAP-HAND productivity progression. Upgrade chain (7 items): Scrap Sorting 10k$ (+2 productivity to 12), Heavy Cutting Tools 15k$ (+2 to 14, gates on Scrap Sorting), Enhanced Tooling 25k$, Scrap Yard Management 40k$, Expand the Shack 60k$, Double the Space, Weaponry Workbench Setup (unlocks Weapons Workbench inside scrap shack for Junk Handgun/Rifle/Autogun crafting). $scrap_hands_amount × 75$/day worker wages + 250$/day if gunsmith operation running. Junkyard also source of: random Junk pickups (scales with junk_rat trait), rare Gun Parts finds, improvised weapons crafting, can get Junkyard Attack random encounter (3 hobos if muscle recruited, solo hobo without). ECON: Junk yielding at ~5/day/scrap_hand × 3-5 hands × 14 productivity = 210-350 Junk/day at full setup → 1 Junk Autogun/day crafted (22 Junk + 1 Gun Part) → sellable in Improvised Weapons Shipment (a weapons shipment contains 5 junk-tier firearms). Junkyard = bottom-rung weapons econ vs I16/Saga-12 (Gun Part intensive, cartel-tier).

Each has specific meta-hint from the in-fiction strategy: Mafia=declare war, Gangs=strength (fight), Bikers=money (500k$ dirty buyout offer as alternative), Cartel=reputation (they voluntarily surrender to a 'new major player'). So all 4 factions have DISTINCT win conditions — combat-war / strength-flex / money-bribe / rep-intimidate — a genuine strategy layer rather than generic 'defeat boss'. (2) Distributor Hackers Quest — intro to Sixth via electronics supply, then befriend hackers via bikers help, unlocks crypto farm. (3) Casino Heist Intel — gas canister chem-request side-quest. (4) Cartel Warehouse Harbor Gangbang — opt-in 'get caught sneaking' flag to unlock the NSFW alt-heist path. (5) Burglars Event — night home defense (7-day cd). RED PHONE (tutorial NPC): 12-hint menu verbatim: 'How do I get money', 'Why do I need reputation', 'How to get more rep', 'How to become better faster stronger', 'Who haven't I found out', shortcuts, more hints, jail mechanics, dice-roll, guns source, un-setup ops, missing skills — dynamic hints reveal based on $gangs_base/$mafia_base/$cartel_base flags.

ACCOMPLICE WORK MECHANICS (Accomplices Widgets — 39 widgets; what each role PRODUCES/day): (1) Thieves: $theft_progress ticks +productivity/day, when >=100 → loot drop per 100 from $thiefs_loot array + 1-10 Junk; multi-100 = multi-drops. Random turf assignment. (2) Hooks: +$hooks_productivity progress, threshold 16 spawns a new slut NPC via createnpc_hook, slut auto-joins workforce (pop: brothel/nc/downtown). (3) Scouts: +cun-scaled bm_progress = amount × 2/day, threshold 100 triggers blackmail-material gen (roll>=7 if depravity<10: topic random(Thievery/Drugs/Bribery/Embezzlement/Tax Evasion)). (4) Drug Dealers: random turf, money drop + heat. Scales with turf_array length (more territory = more earnings). (5) Steroid Dealers: same template, higher base (250 wage + higher sale). (9) Boosters: random turf, per-accomplice boost_p accumulator for car theft boost events. TURF DEPENDENCE: all income roles read random turf from $turfs_array — unowned turfs have no sub-production. So capturing Downtown unlocks 7 drug dealer slots × 200$ wage × random(~300-800)$ earnings = 500-4200$/d. MAX PROFITABLE OPS: 10 Coin Washers × 135$ wage + damping overhead = ~2000$/d laundry cap/day × drug-dealer income = 20k+$/d at full scale post-4-turf-capture, running state-level crime empire.

Each slot is a single NPC. Click NPC opens Accomplices Window dialog (profile + remove option). CREW SKILLS (auto-from-NPC stats, not trained): driver.driving, gunner.combat, safecracker.cun — determine skillcheck difficulty during heist execution (seen in HeistCH / HeistBH / HeistAV widgets — _driver_skillcheck = heist_difficulty ± 2-3 vs crew_driver_skill). So hiring an NPC with cun 15 for safecracker will beat heist_difficulty 7 almost always = guaranteed skillcheck success. TRAIT PROGRESS INCREMENTS (Traits Widgets — per-action progression rates): pickpocketing_success = +10-20/action → 5-10 actions to get base pickpocketer trait (100 threshold). burglar_success = +10-25/action → 4-10 runs to base burglar (100), 8-20 runs to burglar_2 (200). car_thief_success = +10-16/action → 4-10 thefts to car_thief_1 (50 threshold), 8-13 to car_thief_2 (125). melee_success = +20-40/action → 3-5 fights to melee_1 (100), scales up faster (combat-heavy game rewards combat). heister_success = +20-30/action → 4-5 heists for heister trait (100). whore_progress = +8-16/action → 6-12 actions (lower progression speed — harder to max). FAIL widgets also tick (burglar_fail, car_thief_fail, melee_fail, heister_fail, etc) — failure still gives EXP just less than success. observer_progress = +7-10/NPC contact (from earlier note). ALL TRAIT UNLOCKS broadcast 'gang_yapping' pool expansion — accomplices gain new banter lines per earned trait (authentic long-term gameplay flavor). fitness_progress (gym-based), striptease_progress (club-based), gloryhole_progress (sexshop-based), seller/manager/hustler/maid/crypto/camwhore = 4-5-tier soft skill-tree.

BIKERS LEADER VOLKOV VERBATIM (Outskirts bar corner — Russian-mercenary vibe): Broken-English yapping — 'Volkov. You? / Business? / You got money? Dirty? I clean. Three for one. / You got cargo? I ship. Big reward. At the local landing strip. / You bring cash. I bring... solution. And i can help with heat... By doing distraction. Once a week. For 8000$ in clean.' THREE SERVICES offered: (1) Dirty-money laundry 3:1 ratio (3 dirty → 1 clean, best rate in game vs Nightclub 100/pop passive vs Coin Washer 135$/d per accomplice). OUTSKIRTS BUYOUT (post-gang, $outskirts_state=false): Dynamic price = 1000000 - (reputation × 12) dirty. So at rep 10000 = 880k dirty; rep 50000 = 400k dirty; rep 83333 = 0$ (effectively free). At cap rep 30000 (Crime Lord) = 640k dirty. Cheapest territory acquisition in the game — fits quest journal hint 'Bikers' leader loves money immensely. You don't need a knife to beat the greedy - just flash him a copper penny.' MONEY-DRAINED MECHANIC: $dm_cap>=150000 disables exchange ('No more money. Too much. Drained.') — Volkov has a daily cap on how much dirty he can absorb.

MAFIA LEADER ALFA ROMANO VERBATIM (Suburbs Mansion office): Italian-accent-with-English yapping, tailored suit, mahogany desk, blackjack deck on table. FIRST MEET: 'Ah, finalmente! The new hustler I've been hearing about. Benvenuta! I've been waiting for the chance to meet the lady who runs these streets like they're her personal racetrack. My name is Alfa Romano, nice to meet you! Please, make yourself at home. Mi chiamo vincenzo. I like a woman who knows her way around a job, capisce? And I've got a feeling you're gonna like what I have to offer. See, I've got a little operation. Cars, mostly. We find 'em, we take 'em, we make 'em disappear, and voilà! They come back with a whole new identity. But I ain't just about cars. Io amo il gioco! I love the thrill of a good gamble. It's why I'm in the business of buying those casino crowns. Whole design: Italian gangster fantasy trope played straight — contrast with gangs' hip-hop AAVE and bikers' gravelly-broken-English.

PC armed disadvantage vs guards+cartel (higher cun = better evasion of ranged).
